summary: The AITO New M8 launches from 379,800 yuan with four lidar sensors as standard and an L3-level architecture, leading the smart-driving feature race; new car launches are piling up in China; Honda's net profit surges though its auto business remains in the red; NEV consumer focus shifts from price to intelligence.

articles.title: AITO New M8 Launched From RMB 379,800: Four LiDAR Sensors Standard, L3-Grade Autonomous Driving Architecture
articles.summary: The AITO New M8 has officially launched with a starting price of RMB 379,800. Four LiDAR sensors come standard, and the vehicle adopts an L3-grade autonomous driving architecture, with comprehensive upgrades throughout.
articles.detail:
According to NetEase Auto, the AITO New M8 has officially launched with a starting MSRP of RMB 379,800. The car's biggest highlight is its fully loaded autonomous driving hardware: all variants come standard with four LiDAR sensors, and the vehicle adopts L3-grade autonomous driving hardware and software architectures, marking a clear improvement over the previous generation in both perception redundancy and computing power reserves. Beyond autonomous driving, the New M8 has also undergone deep refinements in luxury and ride experience, with the company calling it "more luxurious and better to drive," delivering improvements in interior quality, chassis tuning, and NVH. As AITO's core model in the mid-to-large luxury SUV segment, the New M8 directly competes with the Li L9, NIO ES8, and others in the RMB 400,000 price bracket. Notably, AITO has shifted advanced LiDAR sensors from optional to standard, signaling an aggressive strategy by leading EV startups to popularize advanced autonomous driving.

The pricing and configuration of the AITO New M8 represent a new paradigm in the current premium new energy SUV competition — pre-installed hardware and autonomous driving capability have become core product labels. With L3-grade regulations and liability definitions gradually advancing, vehicles equipped with L3-grade architectures will gain an early advantage in subsequent feature iterations.
articles.impact: Making four LiDAR sensors standard brings advanced autonomous driving to the RMB 400,000 segment, forcing rivals to upgrade hardware specs and accelerating the move of L3-grade autonomous driving from concept to mass production.

articles.title: 吉利星越L PLUS开启预售：15.77万元起，燃油车也能很智能
articles.summary: 吉利星越L PLUS预售价15.77万元起，以智能化配置重塑燃油紧凑级SUV价值标准。
articles.detail:
据网易汽车消息，吉利星越L PLUS已开启预售，预售价15.77万元起。新车主打“燃油车也能如此智能”的产品主张，在智能座舱与智能驾驶辅助方面向同级新能源车型看齐，试图在新能源大潮中为燃油车守住价值阵地。星越L系列一直是吉利在紧凑级SUV市场的销量支柱，此次PLUS版本的推出，意味着吉利在燃油车产品线上继续加码配置升级，以高性价比对抗新能源车型的挤压。15.77万元的预售价区间，直接切入比亚迪宋PLUS、长安CS75 PLUS等热销车型的竞争腹地。

在新能源渗透率持续攀升的当下，吉利并未放弃燃油车赛道，而是通过智能化配置升级延长燃油产品生命周期，同时覆盖对补能便利性、长途续航仍有顾虑的消费群体。
articles.impact: 在新能源主导的15万级SUV市场，星越L PLUS以智能化燃油车定位形成差异化竞争，为传统动力车型的智能化升级提供样本。

articles.title: 2027款领克03家族上市：原厂宽体加持，限时10.38万元起
articles.summary: 2027款领克03家族上市，主打原厂宽体运动造型，限时售价10.38万元起。
articles.detail:
据网易汽车报道，2027款领克03家族正式上市，官方推出限时售价10.38万元起。新车延续领克品牌标志性的运动化产品路线，采用原厂宽体设计，省去了消费者后期改装的成本与合规风险，进一步强化了紧凑级运动轿车的视觉冲击力与个性化属性。领克03家族作为中国品牌性能轿车的代表车型，自推出以来在年轻消费群体中积累了较高关注度，其高性能版本更是在赛道文化与改装圈层中形成独特影响力。此次2027款上市，价格门槛下探至10.38万元限时区间，将与本田思域、大众速腾等合资运动轿车展开正面竞争。

原厂宽体、官方改装风格的设计策略，反映出中国品牌在存量市场中对细分人群的精准运营，通过出厂即改装的方式满足年轻用户对个性化的强烈需求。
articles.impact: 原厂宽体加限时低价的组合，降低年轻消费者运动轿车门槛，或推动紧凑级运动轿车市场进入个性化配置竞争阶段。

articles.title: 奇瑞2027款风云T11更全面：大块头有大智慧
articles.summary: 奇瑞2027款风云T11升级登场，产品力更全面，主攻大空间智能新能源SUV市场。
articles.detail:
据网易汽车报道，奇瑞2027款风云T11迎来升级，官方以“大块头有大智慧”概括新车特点，在空间、智能化与综合产品力上更加全面。风云T11是奇瑞风云序列中的旗舰级SUV车型，定位大空间新能源家用车市场，此次2027款在智能座舱、驾驶辅助及舒适性配置方面进一步补齐短板，提升在中大型新能源SUV市场的竞争力。目前该细分市场由理想、问界、零跑等品牌占据较高份额，奇瑞作为传统自主品牌中新能源转型的代表，正通过风云序列加速产品布局。

风云系列承载着奇瑞新能源高端化的战略任务，2027款T11的“更全面”升级思路，体现出奇瑞在新能源下半场从堆配置转向体系化产品力竞争的策略调整。
articles.impact: 奇瑞以旗舰级SUV完善风云序列产品矩阵，加剧中大型新能源SUV市场的竞争烈度，为消费者提供更多高性价比选择。

articles.title: 专访长安蒋平：安全不做高低配，让安全技术普惠化
articles.summary: 长安汽车蒋平接受专访，强调安全配置不分高低配，要让安全技术实现全民普惠。
articles.detail:
据网易汽车对长安汽车蒋平的专访，长安在产品安全理念上明确提出“安全不做高低配”的原则，即主动安全与被动安全的核心技术不因车型配置等级而区别对待，要让安全技术实现普惠化。这一表态直指当前汽车行业普遍存在的安全配置分级现象——高阶安全技术往往只出现在高配或顶配车型上。与此同时，长安CS75 PLUS蓝鲸超擎版本的实测油耗数据也在近日公布，蓝鲸动力总成的燃油经济性表现受到关注。

在价格战延续的行业背景下，长安选择以安全作为品牌价值锚点，通过核心技术全系标配的方式建立差异化竞争力，而非单纯依赖降价促销。这与近期新能源消费从“问价格”转向“问价值”的趋势相呼应。
articles.impact: 长安以安全技术全系标配策略提升品牌溢价能力，可能推动行业安全配置标准化，促使竞品跟进取消安全配置的高低配差异。

articles.title: 本田净利润大涨66%，但汽车业务仍在亏损
articles.summary: 本田最新财报显示净利润同比大涨66%，但核心汽车业务依然处于亏损状态。
articles.detail:
据百度热搜消息，本田最新财报数据显示，公司净利润同比大幅上涨66%，整体盈利表现亮眼。然而与之形成反差的是，本田的核心汽车业务仍在亏损，利润增长主要依赖摩托车、金融服务等其他业务板块的支撑。这一结构性问题反映出日系车企在电动化转型过程中面临的普遍困境：电动车型投入巨大但规模效应尚未形成，燃油车利润空间又受到市场价格战挤压。

本田此前已宣布调整纯电战略，放缓部分电动车型的投放节奏，并加大对混动（HEV）产品的投入，试图以更具成本优势的动力路线度过转型阵痛期。净利润的大幅增长与汽车业务的持续亏损并存，凸显出传统车企在新旧动能转换期的复杂财务状况。
articles.impact: 本田案例表明仅靠非汽车业务难以长期支撑转型投入，日系车企混动策略能否扭转汽车业务亏损将成为行业观察重点。

articles.title: 日产新NV200 PHEV首发亮相：插混+四驱，还能当床车
articles.summary: 日产新款NV200 PHEV首发亮相，采用插电混动与四驱系统，兼具休旅床车功能。
articles.detail:
据网易汽车报道，日产新款NV200 PHEV车型首发亮相，新车采用插电式混合动力系统并配备四驱功能，同时针对户外与休旅场景进行空间优化，可实现床车式车内休息布局。NV200是日产旗下的经典厢式多功能车型，此次推出PHEV版本，标志着日产在轻型商用车与休旅车领域加速电气化布局。插混+四驱的组合既解决了纯电车型的续航焦虑，又提升了非铺装路面的通过能力，配合灵活多变的车内空间，瞄准了近年快速增长的露营、房车旅行细分市场。

这一产品思路显示出海外车企在电动化路径选择上更加务实，插混与增程等过渡性技术方案正在被广泛应用于更多车型品类。
articles.impact: 插混四驱床车定位切入露营经济细分市场，为中国品牌MPV与休旅车型的户外化、电气化改造提供产品思路参考。

articles.title: 通用汽车全球高级副总裁：中国是推动产品开发和技术迭代的关键力量
articles.summary: 通用汽车全球高级副总裁表示，中国在推动产品开发和技术发展中扮演关键角色。
articles.detail:
据澎湃新闻报道（约8天前发布），通用汽车全球高级副总裁公开表示，中国是推动通用产品开发和技术发展的重要力量。这一表态反映出跨国车企对中国市场战略地位的重新定位——中国不再仅仅是销售市场，更是全球技术研发、产品定义与供应链创新的核心枢纽。近年来，通用、大众、丰田等国际车企纷纷加大在华研发投入，设立本土研发中心，并依托中国成熟的智能电动车供应链加速产品迭代。

在电动化与智能化赛道上，中国市场的竞争强度与技术演进速度均处于全球领先位置，跨国车企通过在华布局可快速获取技术能力与市场反馈，再反哺全球产品线。通用此举也与中国新能源消费趋势向智能化、高价值方向转变的行业背景相契合。
articles.impact: 跨国车企将中国定位为研发与创新中心，有望带动更多全球车型首发中国技术，进一步强化中国在全球汽车产业链中的话语权。

articles.title: Smart Driving Hardware Race Heats Up: 896-Line LiDAR Hits the Road, Voyah Zhiyin 2027 Edition Starts at 197,900 Yuan
articles.summary: The 2027 Voyah Zhiyin launches at 197,900 yuan with an 896-line LiDAR and optional all-wheel drive, pushing smart driving hardware specs to new highs.
articles.detail:
According to NetEase Auto, the 2027 Voyah Zhiyin has officially launched, priced from 197,900 yuan. The new model features an 896-line LiDAR with an optional all-wheel-drive version. This LiDAR line count represents a leap beyond the current mainstream 128-line and 192-line products, meaning point-cloud density and perception accuracy will increase substantially. Combined with today's AITO New M8, which comes standard with four LiDARs in an L3-level architecture, it is clear that advanced smart driving hardware is rapidly penetrating from flagship models into the 200,000-yuan market segment.

Continued declines in LiDAR costs are a key driver of this trend. Previously, advanced LiDAR solutions were mostly found in vehicles priced above 300,000 yuan; now the 197,900-yuan Voyah Zhiyin offers 896-line hardware, showing that the supply-chain cost curve is on a fast downward trajectory. For consumers, the enhanced perception from hardware redundancy translates directly into a safer, more reliable assisted driving experience.
articles.impact: LiDAR technology reaching 896 lines in 200,000-yuan-class vehicles marks the dawn of the ultra-high-line-count era for smart driving hardware, accelerating the adoption of advanced driver assistance across mainstream price segments.

articles.title: Shift in EV Buying Behavior: Price Is No Longer the First Question When Buying a New Energy Vehicle
articles.summary: Industry observations show that EV purchase decisions have shifted from price toward smart features, brand value and overall product strength.
articles.detail:
According to the industry analysis piece "Price Is No Longer the First Question When Buying a New Energy Vehicle," the focus of EV purchase decisions is changing significantly — consumers no longer fixate solely on sticker price, but place greater weight on intelligent driving capability, smart cockpit experience, brand service systems and resale value. This trend closely matches the product strategies of several recent launches: the AITO New M8 with four standard LiDARs, the Voyah Zhiyin with an 896-line LiDAR, the Geely Xingyue L PLUS emphasizing smart features for combustion vehicles, and Changan highlighting accessible safety technology — all showing automakers shifting the competitive focus from price wars to technology and value wars.

After multiple rounds of price wars, consumers have become less sensitive to simple price cuts, while remaining highly alert to trimmed configurations and reduced quality. The new energy vehicle market is moving from a "price-driven" phase into a "value-driven" phase, placing higher demands on automakers' R&D investment and brand building.
articles.impact: As consumer decisions shift from price to value, automakers will be pushed to cut low-quality price cuts and instead invest more in smart and safety features, returning industry competition to the fundamentals of product strength.

articles.title: L3-Architecture Mass Production Era Nears: Smart-Driving Hardware Redundancy to Become Standard on Mid-to-High-End Models
articles.summary: With models such as the AITO New M8 standardizing L3-level architecture and multiple LiDAR units, mass deployment of L3 autonomous driving is expected to accelerate.
articles.detail:
From the AITO New M8 shipping standard with four LiDAR sensors and an L3-level autonomous driving architecture, to the Voyah Zhiyin carrying an 896-line LiDAR, it is foreseeable that 2027 will be the year advanced smart-driving hardware becomes widespread. As core components such as LiDAR and high-compute chips continue to drop in cost, models equipped with L3-level hardware redundancy will gradually expand from 400,000-yuan flagships to the 200,000-yuan mainstream market. For automakers, pre-installing hardware is only the first step; subsequent software iteration capability, scale of data accumulation, and regulatory compliance progress will determine the actual pace at which L3-level features come to market.

Looking ahead, smart-driving hardware specifications are poised to cease being a marketing gimmick and become one of the core parameters influencing purchase decisions. At the same time, as regulations defining L3-level liability are refined, automakers that complete compliance certification first will gain a significant first-mover advantage.
articles.impact: Smart-driving hardware redundancy is becoming standard; multiple LiDAR units are expected to be widely adopted across mainstream mid-to-high-end models within the next year, as competition over L3 feature deployment kicks off in earnest.

articles.title: JV and PHEV New Track: Japanese Automakers Turn Pragmatic, Safety and Value Become the Key to Breaking Through
articles.summary: Honda's auto business is losing money, Nissan pushes plug-in hybrids — Japanese automakers' transition grows more pragmatic, while Chinese brands capture the value high ground with accessible safety.
articles.detail:
A roundup of today's news shows the auto industry's competitive landscape entering a new phase of divergence. On one hand, Honda posted a surge in net profit but its auto business remains in the red, while Nissan launched the NV200 PHEV all-wheel-drive plug-in hybrid — a clear sign that Japanese automakers' electrification strategies are turning pragmatic, with plug-in hybrids and hybrids serving as the dominant transitional technology routes. On the other hand, Chinese brands continue to invest in intelligence and safety value — Changan explicitly promotes the democratization of safety technology, Geely brings smart features to internal combustion models, and Chery addresses gaps in its flagship product lineup.

Meanwhile, the shift in new energy consumption from "asking about price" to "asking about value" means the low-quality, low-price competitive model is losing its edge. In the period ahead, brands that build reputation across all three dimensions — autonomous driving, safety features, and product reliability — will enjoy more sustained growth momentum in a market defined by stock competition. Competition between joint ventures and domestic brands will escalate from a price war to a comprehensive contest of systemic capability.
articles.impact: Japanese pragmatic PHEV strategies and Chinese brands' value-upgrading paths are running in parallel; industry price wars are expected to gradually cool, with safety, intelligence, and quality becoming the next main battlefield of competition.
